# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# jaxlib IS THE ULP-STABILITY DEPENDENCY -- ITS PIN IS LOAD-BEARING.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# jaxlib ships the XLA compiler. XLA is free to change reduction order, kernel
# fusion and vectorisation between releases, all of which are legal
# floating-point transformations that nonetheless move the last bits of a
# result. The repo's central contract -- that every noise channel switched off
# reproduces the committed golden trajectories, and that noise attribution is
# therefore a property of the physics rather than of the toolchain -- is checked
# at 0 ULP by
#
#     SOLITON_STRICT_ULP=1 pytest tests/test_noise_off_identity.py
#
# That check is meaningful only against the exact jaxlib the goldens were
# produced with. tests/data/golden/*.provenance.json records it, the `identity`
# CI job runs on this lock and nothing else, and the version below matches those
# sidecars. Bumping jaxlib is therefore a deliberate act with a procedure:
# regenerate the goldens, verify the change is ULP-scale rather than physical,
# and justify it in the PR (see CONTRIBUTING.md). It is not a routine
# dependency refresh.
#
# The other pins are ordinary reproducibility hygiene; this one is the
# experiment's reference frame.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
